plugin.title: Users and access
plugin.description: Manage users, groups and access control.

phrases.users_access_help: Manage user accounts, groups and explicit ACL permissions.
phrases.users_help: Each user belongs to exactly one global group.
phrases.groups_acl_help: Group permissions for pages, plugin handlers and content types.
phrases.has_api_help: Users in this group can create and use personal API tokens within their existing permissions.
phrases.password_help: Leave empty to keep the current password. New users may also be created without a password for external authentication.
phrases.pages_help: Pages are explicit resources and already belong to a domain.
phrases.plugins_help: A checked handler grants this group access to that plugin capability.
phrases.content_help: Core capabilities are view, create, edit and delete. Plugin-specific workflow permissions belong to plugins.
